# The committed survivor set for the archived_url invariant. One HuggingFace repo id
# per line, sorted, for every harvested nomen in parse/data/huggingface_nomina.json
# that carries an archive.org snapshot of its live repo URL.
#
# archived_url is the ONLY durable record of a model card that later disappears from
# the Hub, and cmd/bestiary-hf rewrites huggingface_nomina.json wholesale on every
# harvest. A count alone cannot catch an erasure that coincides with an addition, so
# the SET is pinned here: a survivor that loses its snapshot fails by repo name.
#
# Regenerate ONLY at a declared, reviewed capture point, in the commit that declares
# it. Regenerating to turn a red gate green is the failure this file exists to catch.
